description: This file defines structures, enums, and function prototypes for handling In-Band Interrupts (IBI) in the I3C protocol within the Zephyr RTOS. It includes definitions for IBI types, payloads, work queue management, and callback functions.

methods.name: i3c_ibi_work_enqueue
methods.description: Queues an IBI work item for future processing, copying the provided work structure into internal queue.

methods.name: i3c_ibi_work_enqueue_target_irq
methods.description: Queues a target interrupt IBI with specified payload for future processing.

methods.name: i3c_ibi_work_enqueue_hotjoin
methods.description: Queues a hot join IBI for future processing.

methods.name: i3c_ibi_work_enqueue_cb
methods.description: Queues a generic callback for future processing.
